messages:
jules: quick RFC follow-up: i prototyped a chunked-bloom prefetch index for air-gapped installs. idea is to ship a tiny bloom+manifest that tells the operator which chunks to stage locally before activation. reduces seed size and avoids pulling full model blobs. want feedback on failure modes and operator UX.

rahul: interesting. main nit: bloom false positives -> unnecessary staging. need configurable fpp and chunk sizing. also how do we ensure a false positive doesn't lead to missing critical chunks at activation?

emma: we can pair bloom with a lightweight verification vector per-chunk (e.g., a 4-byte checksum + seq) signed by release key. operator runs preflight: bloom => candidate chunk list => verify vector fetch from repo mirror (small) => final list. that reduces fetches and keeps safety.

liam: UX concern: operators hate magic. preflight must be fully reproducible offline. propose `dryrun.activate` mode that simulates activation and emits an action plan containing: chunks_to_stage, rollback_anchor, estimated activation_time, and risk_flags.

jules: +1 for dryrun.activate. also: what about partial activation rollback? if activation fails after some chunks replaced, we need idempotent rollback. maybe apply in ephemeral mount, switch symlink once all checks pass.

rahul: symlink swap is good. add an activation-anchor file that records old and new anchors and signed commit. anchor size should be minimal so it can be shipped in airgap manifests.

emma: signing story: signer-bot can issue per-release V2 signatures for vectors and anchors. we should rotate keys but expose KMS thumbprint in the index so operator can verify signer identity without online KMS.

signer-bot: signer-bot: signed vector v2 created for release 2026-03-12; id=rv2-174632; thumbprint=sha256:deadbeef

liam: corner case: dedupe across components -> chunk ownership ambiguous. who owns deletion/GC? operator-run GC must be conservative: only remove chunks absent from all pinned anchors and older than X days. document GC policy.

jules: agree. add a `pin` section in the merged manifest listing anchors to keep. that lets operator GC aggressively when pins are pruned.

rahul: performance: bloom size tradeoff vs false positives. give heuristics in RFC: for model shards aim fpp=1e-6 => bloom 1.2MB per 10k chunks. for runtime artifacts we can be more aggressive. include formula.

emma: also record chunk priorities: `critical`, `optional`, `lazy`. critical must be staged pre-activation, optional can be background fetched, lazy left to runtime cache. helps operator plan bandwidth.

ops-bot: ops-bot: kicked off staging preflight (job pf-2201). will upload /var/log/preflight/staging-2/pf-2201.json on completion.

jules: sample preflight output (toy):

```
{
  "release": "rv2-174632",
  "bloom_fpp": "1e-6",
  "chunks_to_stage": ["c1","c34","c78"],
  "missing_critical": [],
  "risk_flags": ["bloom-fpp:1e-6","dedupe-ambiguous"],
  "rollback_anchor": "anchor-173900"
}
```

liam: excellent. one more ops detail: ensure preflight exit codes are stable: 0=ok, 2=soft-fail (can continue with warning), 3=hard-fail. operators will script around that.

emma: telemetry: capture preflight_time_ms, staged_bytes, missing_critical_count, activation_swap_time. we must avoid PII and keep only counters/histograms.

jules: next steps i propose: 1) add chunk priority + pin semantics to merged index spec (emma + jules) 2) bloom heuristics and formula doc (rahul) 3) dryrun.activate CLI and exit code contract (liam + ops) 4) signer-bot integration + anchor format (emma + signer-bot). i'll file RFC stub and attach prototypes.

signer-bot: signer-bot: anchor signed anchor-174632 by rvk-ops-2026; sig=sha256:beefcafe

jules: thanks everyone. i'll post RFC link here when created. if anyone wants to flip the canary proxy for preflight-only mode we can test on staging-2 next week. :rocket:
